full_judgment: 3. This petitioners as defendant No. 1 has been contesting the suit by filing written statement stains interlaid that the suit is not maintainable that the suit is barred by the prince of res-judicata. The further case of the petitioner is that the opposite party No while owing and possessing the suit property entered into an agreement with petitioner on 1. 1. 1969 to sell the same and subsequently the petitioner got the specific performance of the said contract in the title suit No. 306 of 1969 and got the Kabala Deed No. 15 8 92 dated 6. 10. 1993 registries through court Vide Title Execution Case No. 21 of 1981 and obtained possession of the suit property (In part) vide title Execution case No. 3 of 1984 (renumbered on transfer) and was waiting for obtaining possession of the rest of the suit property. It is further asserted that the plaintiff opposite parties preferred title Appeal No. 92 of 198(1 against the aforesaid judgment and decree which on transfer being dismissed by the 5111 Additional District Judge. Dhaka Civil Revision No. 1146 of 1991 was preferred before this court by the opposite party Nos. 1-5 which however was discharged for default on 26. 2. 1982 and subsequently and revise petition thereon also being discharged civil Appeal No. 117 of 1989 was preferred before the Appellate Division of this court which was also dismissed on 31. 3. 1993. It is further stated in the written statement that the plaintiff opposite party No. 3 also filed civil revision No. 695 of 1985 against the part delivery of possession of the suit land vide Title Execution Case No. 3 of 1984 and the Rule of that Civil Revision was also discharged 13. 4. 1988. It is asserted by the defendant petitioner in the written statement that being unsuccessful in the aforesaid case the plaintiff opposite party Nos. I filed Title suit No. 172 of 1984 before the Assistant Judge. Kenaiganj challenging the petitioners aforesaid Sale Deed which was dismissed for default on 11. 2. 1985. Thereafter they filed another title suit being Title suit No. 826 or 1985 before the 2nd sub-Judge Dhaka for declaration of their title in the suit land and ultimately withdrew the suit to use affresh subsequently and thereafter filed the instant title suit No. 8 of 1982.
